value.0: With a winning smile and a gregarious disposition, this Zabrak stands behind a stall filled with knock-off brands of holocommunicators and other techno-gadgets.

Czerka Corporation is a massive, galaxy spanning corporate entity which engages in all manner of business, especially anything to do with war. They are highly controversial, especially as many of their major holdings are in space now controlled by the Sith Empire. While this has received some attention by the Republic Senate, Czerka has not received sanctions for continued business there, assuring the galaxy they are careful to comply with all sanctions on Darth Malaks empire and do not supply enemy forces.

Czerka has a sizable security force, the Czerka Ranger Corps. Private security, mercenaries and bounty hunters flock to it, eager for the generous pay Czerka employees are known to receive. It works well for them, so long as they remember - dont cross Czerka, and "no questions asked" means "no questions asked."

In Veles, these Czerka Rangers are largely responsible for maintaining law and order in the colony, and they toe a careful line between enforcing company policy while ensuring that any resentment amongst the colonists does not grow out of control. In some ways, the Czerka Rangers of Veles therefore need to be almost as much diplomats and friendly beat cops as much as soldiers.

Harry Mason is a man known about Veles as having an enduring hatred of the Mandalorians. Word on the street is that he lost his home back during the Mandalorian War, and that grudge he had nursed since then.

There are many survivors of the Mandalorian Wars who have came to settle in Veles, and Orlando is known as one of those. He has a distrust of the Mandalorians, taking seriously any such threat to his newfound home.

The largest population centre on Viscara is Veles, a burgeoning city with a fast-growing population as refugees and colonists from across the Randon sector stream towards the planet. Some are forced to seek refuge amidst the turmoil of war, while others are attracted by the opportunities that Czerka corporation has been offering. As rumors abound of riches and secrets hidden within Viscara's crust, the population of Veles has grown into the tens of thousands.

Czerka Corporation is a massive, galaxy spanning corporate entity which engages in all manner of business, especially anything to do with war. They are highly controversial, especially as many of their major holdings are in space now controlled by the Sith Empire. While this has received some attention by the Republic Senate, Czerka has not received sanctions for continued business there, assuring the galaxy they are careful to comply with all sanctions on Darth Malaks empire and do not supply enemy forces.

Czerka has a sizable security force, the Czerka Ranger Corps. Private security, mercenaries and bounty hunters flock to it, eager for the generous pay Czerka employees are known to receive. It works well for them, so long as they remember - dont cross Czerka, and "no questions asked" means "no questions asked."

In Veles, these Czerka Rangers are largely responsible for maintaining law and order in the colony, and they toe a careful line between enforcing company policy while ensuring that any resentment amongst the colonists does not grow out of control. In some ways, the Czerka Rangers of Veles therefore need to be almost as much diplomats and friendly beat cops as much as soldiers.

OOC:
In loving memory of Jacob - known to us as Webber. He was a good friend and a pillar of our community, always helpful to newcomers and a beloved part of what makes SWLOR special. 

He was a brilliant writer, expressive and intriguing, kind, and able to share his creativity with dozens of people from all over the world. It was a loving pleasure and honor to have known such a loving person and it is with great regret that we will not see what future he could have brought for the world.

He is and will always be missed.

A stone with alien carvings stand here. Locals claim that it predates the establishment of Veles, while others snidely say that Czerka planted it to add an air of mysticism to the Veles garden; a cynical attempt to attract tourists who would spend credits in their colony. Most inhabitants of Veles tend to be fond of it, however, and some believe that making small offerings of flowers or stray credits may give good fortune.

These garden gnomes litter the Veles corpo garden, and are taken to be a sign of either amusement or misfortune by the locals. There are even some who claim that Czerka had planted miniature holo-cameras in them to spy on those who come and go about the garden.

They are very popular with the children of the colony, who enjoy kicking them over.
